form.name: Product name
form.typeComboDescription: Several products sold as one priced unit
form.productTypeLockedHint: Product type is set when the product is created and cannot be changed.
form.descriptionHelper: Shown on your storefront product page. Use headings, lists and tables for size charts or care instructions.
form.barcodeTooltip: The barcode printed on the product packaging. Scan it with a reader or type it in. Leave empty to auto-generate a barcode you can print labels for.
form.barcodeSymbologyHint: Shared by every variant of this product.
form.expiryAlertDaysTooltip: How many days before the expiry date the product should start appearing in expiry alerts, so you have time to act on soon-to-expire stock.
form.unitIdTooltip: The unit all stock is counted and reported in (e.g. Piece). Choose carefully — every quantity, including purchases and sales, is recorded in this unit.
form.enableUOMConversionHint: e.g. buy in Boxes from supplier, sell in Pieces at the counter.
form.purchaseUnitTooltip: The unit you buy this product in (e.g. Box). Stock received in this unit is converted to the base unit using the conversion factor.
form.purchaseConversionFactorTooltip: How many base units make up one purchase unit. For example, if you buy in Boxes and 1 box holds 100 pieces, enter 100.
form.openingStockTooltip: The quantity currently in stock at this location, entered in the product's base unit. Recorded as an opening-stock entry you can report on later; adjust it afterwards from the Inventory page.
form.costPriceTooltip: Unit cost of the opening stock. Used for inventory valuation and the opening-stock report.
form.inventoryAlertLevelTooltip: When stock falls to or below this number, the product is flagged as low stock and added to your reorder shortlist so you know when to restock.
form.batchNumberTooltip: Batch/lot number for the opening-stock batch. Only applied when expiry tracking is on for this product.
form.expiryDateTooltip: Expiry date for the opening-stock batch. Only applied when expiry tracking is on for this product.
form.imagesDropzone: Square 1600 × 1600 px works best · PNG, JPG, WEBP up to 5MB · Max 5 images
form.hasExpiryTooltip: Records stock in batches with expiry dates, so it sells earliest-expiry-first and appears in expiry alerts. Turning this off later requires the product's stock to be zero at every location — batches cannot be left behind holding stock.
form.onlinePriceTooltip: Leave empty to sell online at the same price you set above.
form.weightKgTooltip: Used to book courier consignments. Left empty, the courier bills at its own fallback weight — usually more than the parcel actually weighs.
form.featuredTooltip: Surfaces this product in your storefront's featured rails.

sheet.title: Update tags & categories from a sheet
sheet.description: Change the tags and categories of many products in Excel or Google Sheets, then upload the file.
sheet.step1: Download the sheet. It lists the products in your current filter.
sheet.step2: Edit the Category, Subcategory and Tags columns. Separate several tags with |. Leave Name and Barcode as they are.
sheet.step3: Upload it and check the changes before applying.
sheet.rules: An empty Category or Tags cell removes it from that product. A column you delete from the sheet is left alone.
sheet.changed: {count, plural, one {# product will change} other {# products will change}}
sheet.invalid: {count, plural, one {# row has a problem} other {# rows have problems}}
sheet.apply: Apply {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}}
sheet.done: {count, plural, one {# product updated} other {# products updated}}

form.defaultTaxHint: Prefilled on new products in this category, on both the purchase and the sales side. Leave empty to inherit: a sub-category falls back to its parent's rate, a top-level one to the organization default. Existing products are never re-priced.

applyVat.tooltip: Apply this category's VAT rate to its products
applyVat.title: Apply VAT rate to products?
applyVat.body: This sets every product in “{category}” ({count}) to {rate}, on both the purchase and the sales side.
applyVat.overwrites: It replaces each product's current rate — including any you set individually.
applyVat.postedSafe: Invoices already issued are not changed. They keep the rate they were issued with.
